facts.text: Delaware State University offers a four-year, full-tuition Inspire Scholarship to eligible Delaware high school graduates who enroll full time right after graduation with at least a 2.75 cumulative GPA.

sources.title: Inspire Scholarship
sources.quote: Delaware State University offers a 4-year, full tuition Inspire Scholarship available to qualifying Delaware high school graduates who enroll at Delaware State University in the fall semester right after high school graduation.

sources.title: Inspire Scholarship
sources.quote: To apply, you must have a cumulative overall GPA of at least 2.75 or higher on a 4.0 scale, as indicated on your official high school transcript.
